policy.final_confirmatory_cases: must be designated and sealed before result access
policy.post_access_change: if a sealed confirmatory result is opened and a later scientific design or code change occurs, retire the affected case from confirmation and use fresh identities
policy.claim_wording: prospective post-exposure qualification; value-uninspected design only where this ledger and source-of-record support that statement

historical_exposure.design_lineage_note: No v0.1 scientific values are recorded as inputs to the v0.5/Draft-B design. Historical existence/exposure prevents describing the overall design as predating v0.1.

deletion_rule: Do not delete prior entries; corrections are additive and identify the superseded entry.
